name: inferCSN
method_summary: inferCSN infers cell type and cell state specific gene regulatory networks from scRNA-seq data by combining pseudotime/state information with sparse regression models. The CRAN implementation selected here exposes the sparse-regression network inference core, fitting target genes from candidate regulators with L0/L0L1/L0L2 regularization and optionally filtering the inferred network with reciprocal-weight or pseudotime transfer-entropy sifting.

threading.upstream_mapping: Wrapper maps ANDREA --threads to inferCSN::inferCSN(cores=threads), inferCSN::network_sift(cores=threads) for sift_method=max, and parallel::mclapply(mc.cores=threads) in the entropy compatibility path. The wrapper pins common BLAS/OpenMP environment variables to 1 to avoid nested parallelism; current cost profiles cover 1, 2, 4 and 8 assigned threads.

required.usage: Required because inferCSN is exposed only as execution.mode=group_emulated: ANDREA partitions the full expression matrix by groups.tsv and each physical inferCSN run receives one group's cells.

optional.usage: Wrapper validates tf_list.txt against expression genes and passes it as inferCSN regulators; if absent, the wrapper omits regulators to preserve inferCSN's all-gene default.

conditional_required.message: pseudotime is required when sift_method=entropy because inferCSN network_sift() needs pseudotime-ordered cell metadata.
conditional_required.usage: Required for sift_method=entropy because wrapper calls inferCSN network_sift() with pseudotime-ordered metadata for the current group.

progress.note: inferCSN iterates over target genes internally, and network_sift(method=entropy) iterates over gene pairs, but the selected public entrypoints do not expose stable callbacks or parseable progress counters; the wrapper should report coarse lifecycle states in progress.json.

penalty.description: Sparse regression penalty passed to inferCSN(). Upstream documents L0, L0L1 and L0L2, with L0 as the default.

cross_validation.description: Whether inferCSN should use L0Learn cross-validation when fitting each target-gene sparse regression model.

seed.description: Random seed used by inferCSN for cross-validation and subsampling.

n_folds.description: Number of folds passed to L0Learn cross-validation when cross_validation=true.

subsampling_method.description: Upstream subsampling strategy used before sparse regression when subsampling_ratio < 1.

subsampling_ratio.description: Fraction of cells used by inferCSN subsampling. A value of 1 preserves the full input matrix and skips subsampling.

r_squared_threshold.description: Minimum model R2 required before retaining normalized target-gene coefficients; targets with R2 at or below this threshold yield zero coefficients that are omitted from network.csv.

sift_method.description: Optional post-inference network_sift mode. none preserves the inferCSN() table; max keeps the stronger reciprocal direction; entropy filters with pseudotime transfer entropy and requires pseudotime.tsv.

entropy_method.description: Entropy estimator passed to network_sift() when sift_method=entropy.

effective_entropy.description: Whether network_sift() should use effective transfer entropy when sift_method=entropy.

shuffles.description: Number of shuffles passed to network_sift() for effective transfer entropy. Upstream resets this to 0 when effective_entropy=false and to at least 10 when effective_entropy=true.

entropy_nboot.description: Number of bootstrap replications passed to network_sift() for transfer-entropy p values.

lag_value.description: Markov lag order used by network_sift() transfer entropy when sift_method=entropy.

entropy_p_value.description: P value threshold used by network_sift() to filter transfer-entropy edges when entropy_nboot > 1.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr log from the inferCSN run.
Raw regulator-target-weight table returned by inferCSN() before optional network_sift() filtering.
